basis: The dashboard legend maps pale yellow to the 'High' (100) end of the risk scale and dark maroon to the 'Low' (0) end. Among the options, Illinois (IL) is shaded pale yellow (highest), Delaware (DE) is orange (mid-range), and Kansas (KS) is dark maroon (lowest). The task requires selecting the highest-risk state for priority follow-up.
